name: Boguslaus IV
note: co-ruler of the Duchy of Pomerania with Barnim II and Otto I; from 1295 partition Duke of Wolgast (to 1309)

name: Otto I
note: co-ruler in Pomerania until 1295, then Duke of Stettin

name: Otto III
note: died without descendants; Stettin annexed to Wolgast

name: Barnim IX the Pious
note: co-ruler in Pomerania until 1531, then Duke of Stettin

name: Philip II the Pious
note: brothers George II (Darłowo), Francis (Barth) and Boguslaus XIV (Darłowo) held parts

name: Francis
note: table reign from 1606, at Barth until 1618

name: Boguslaus XIV [XII] the Sociable
note: at Darłowo until 1620; reunited all Pomerania 1625; died without heirs 1637, Pomerania held by Sweden and Brandenburg
